warning: Sanitized historical example. Not installation authority or current inventory.

source.initialInstallPolicy: immutable checksum and reviewed installer identity

application.versionRelationship: application, embedded CLI, and System Extension must be one signed vendor release

networkBoundary.macRole: control surface and outbound SSH client
networkBoundary.transport: SSH over Tailscale with the dedicated public key

lifecycle.install: Verify the fixed official package, Apple notarization, installer identity, and collision-free prestate, invoke the vendor package only through commit-bound nix-darwin activation, and install the reviewed exact CLI wrapper from the immutable Nix store if the vendor postinstall leaves it absent
lifecycle.installedSmoke: Verify the receipt, signed application, embedded CLI and System Extension, vendor companions, marker, and continued absence of Mac inbound SSH
lifecycle.connectedDoctor: After the owner action, emit only booleans for System Extension enablement, backend connectivity, one or more overlay addresses, no route or exit-node advertisement, and Mac inbound SSH remaining off
lifecycle.rollbackBeforeConsent: Activation removes only newly created exact managed payloads if the System Extension has not entered consent-bearing state
lifecycle.rollbackAfterConsent: Use a new exact disabled-state commit and the official bounded owner uninstall flow; never erase profiles, authentication files, Keychain items, or support data automatically
lifecycle.remove: Fail closed when consent-bearing or authenticated state may exist and request the bounded owner uninstall action
